programme.title: Incredible Engineering Blunders: Fixed
programme.desc: Former aerospace engineer Justin Cunningham and his team of reporters explore the world's most bizarre engineering mistakes and set about finding workable solutions to these problems. Episodes follow real stories, such as an airport that has sunk into the sea, wind turbines that are in danger of falling into the ocean and a skyscraper that has the potential to melt cars. programme.title: Cooper's Treasure
programme.desc: Considered one of NASA's original space pioneers, astronaut Gordon Cooper discovered something extraordinary on a 1963 mission. While circling Earth during a 122-hour flight to detect nuclear sites, Cooper photographed more than 100 anomalies around the South Caribbean. He later believed the dark patches that appeared on the photos to be sunken ships, and while working for decades in secret, Gordon created a map that he thought could uncover treasures worth billions of dollars. Before passing away, he shared his meticulous research with longtime friend Darrell Miklos, and now Miklos is teaming with seasoned explorers and researchers to finally make good on Gordon's dream.

programme.title: Secrets of the Underground
programme.desc: A fascinating new world has emerged for scientists to study, and it's just beneath their feet. With the emergence of cutting-edge technologies such as ground penetrating radar, LIDAR (Light Detection and Ranging), and 3-D imaging, scientists are now able to research underworlds of secret tunnel networks, ancient structures, and bizarre geological occurrences that offer glimpses into the past. In `Secrets of the Underground', Rob Nelson, an ecologist by trade and an explorer by pastime, travels the country to investigate long-lost, subterranean phenomena. Nelson looks at all things hidden, covert and unfamiliar, from intricate and forgotten sewers and caves to lost civilizations and structures.

programme.desc: Considered one of NASA's original space pioneers, astronaut Gordon Cooper discovered something extraordinary on a 1963 mission. While circling Earth during a 122-hour flight to detect nuclear sites, Cooper photographed more than 100 anomalies around the South Caribbean. He later believed the dark patches that appeared on the photos to be sunken ships, and while working for decades in secret, Gordon created a map that he thought could uncover treasures worth billions of dollars. Before passing away, he shared his meticulous research with longtime friend Darrell Miklos, and now Miklos is teaming with seasoned explorers and researchers to finally make good on Gordon's dream.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants

programme.title: Kamp Koral: SpongeBob's Under Years

programme.desc: S2 — Koral: Two Roxies The Roxie sisters go their separate ways; The Dinghy cabin kids discover life after dark.
programme.title: Kamp Koral: SpongeBob's Under Years

programme.desc: S1 E1 — The Jellyfish Kid A young SpongeBob is determined to catch his first jellyfish, so his friends do whatever they can to help him.
programme.title: Kamp Koral: SpongeBob's Under Years

programme.desc: S1 E4 — What a Gem; Family Spirit Alvin believes a neighbour is responsible for a recent diamond heist. Alvin tries to get out of the annual family day picnic with Dave to go to a big soccer game.
programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks

programme.desc: S1 E5 — The App; Don Juan Theodoro Dave gets a parenting app to help supervise the Chipmunks. Alvin, Simon and the Chipettes give Theodore conflicting dating advice when they believe he has a crush on a girl.
programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants

programme.desc: S1 E3 — Jellyfishing; Plankton While Squidward recovers from a bicycle accident, SpongeBob and Patrick take him jellyfishing. SpongeBob falls victim to a scheme by the evil Plankton.
programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants

programme.desc: S1 E4 — Naughty Nautical Neighbors; Boating School Squidward plays a joke on SpongeBob and Patrick, but the joke backfires on Squidward. It's exam time again at Mrs Puff's Boating School.
programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants

programme.desc: S1 E7 — To Serve and Protect; Kickin' It Old School Simon is ecstatic when he is elected as the school's safety monitor. Dave brings the Chipmunks on a technology-free camping trip.
programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks

programme.desc: S1 E9 — My Sister the Weirdo; Turf War Jeanette seeks Alvin's advice when she wants to give a toast to Brittany at her upcoming party. Alvin decides to borrow Brittany's babysitting job.
programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks

programme.desc: S1 E11 — Mystic Mountain; Candy Confessions Dave worries that the Chipmunks have become addicted to a video game. A grounded Alvin begs Theodore to buy him a limited edition skateboard.
programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks

programme.desc: S10 E2 — Mimic Madness; House Worming SpongeBob learns that imitation is the sincerest form of flattery. When worms move in to SpongeBob's holes, he has to hide his disgusting new friends from everyone else.
programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants

programme.desc: S12 E7 — Broken Alarm; Karen's Baby SpongeBob breaks his precious alarm clock. Then Karen quickly learns that kids grow up too fast after her new child arrives in the mail.
programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants

programme.desc: S1 E3 — Quest for Tire; A Cabin of Curiosities The weekly food delivery truck goes missing, so the campers must hunt it down like their primal ancestors. A mysterious cabin of odd campers have frightful fun with SpongeBob and Patrick after dark.
programme.title: Kamp Koral: SpongeBob's Under Years

programme.desc: S1 E4 — In Search of Camp Noodist; Kitchen Sponge SpongeBob, Sandy, and Patrick hike through the woods in search of a fabled nudist colony; SpongeBob helps Plankton at the Krusty Kanteen, leading to the development of a very familiar sandwich.
programme.title: Kamp Koral: SpongeBob's Under Years

programme.desc: S1 E14 — Safety Third; Mister Manners Alvin convinces Simon to build him an exact replica of a dangerous toy sports car; Alvin must pass a manners course to prove he is worthy of meeting a princess.
programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks

programme.desc: S1 E15 — The Tree House; Saving Simon While cleaning out their treehouse, the girls reminisce about how they saved the tree from being cut down; Alvin and Theodore think that Simon is going away to boarding school.
programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks

programme.desc: S8 E24 — The Good Krabby Name; Move It or Lose It SpongeBob and Patrick go on an advertising blitz. Mr. Krabs and Plankton issue petitions to get their rival's restaurant bulldozed.
programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants

programme.desc: S7 E19 — The Great Patty Caper When the key to the vault holding the Krabby Patty recipe is lost, SpongeBob must locate it before the recipe is lost forever.
programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants

programme.desc: S1 E14 — Help Not Wanted; Camp Spirit Patrick's dad unexpectedly visits Kamp Koral. SpongeBob, Patrick and Sandy befriend a visiting ghost camper.
programme.title: Kamp Koral: SpongeBob's Under Years

programme.desc: S1 E15 — Hill Fu; Sun's Out, Fun's Out It's the annual foam-fisted all-camp karate battle, and SpongeBob trains to beat the butt-kicking Sandy. It's the hottest day of summer, but there's only one AC in the whole camp.
programme.title: Kamp Koral: SpongeBob's Under Years

programme.desc: S1 E16 — Back to School; Bromance Dave finds himself in school with Alvin after he discovers that he never graduated from high school; Simon's new friend decides to ditch him to spend time with Alvin.
programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks

programme.desc: S1 E17 — A Room of One's Own; Carts and Crafts Alvin convinces Dave to give him his own room; after Alvin inadvertently destroys Theodore's bike, he enters the boys in a round up of shopping carts where the first prize is a new bike.
programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks

programme.desc: S6 E19 — Pineapple Fever; Chum Caverns Squidward gets stuck indoors with SpongeBob and Patrick during a storm. Plankton creates an underground restaurant that threatens to put the Krusty Krab out of business.
programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants

programme.desc: S5 E20 — The Pest of the West SpongeBob discovers that he was related to the great Western hero, SpongeBuck. Hired as the sheriff of Dead Eye Gulch, he must reclaim the town from no-good Dead Eye Plankton.
programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants

programme.title: Kamp Koral: SpongeBob's Under Years

programme.desc: S2 E1 — Mad Science Squirrel; To Pop a Bubble Plankton recruits Sandy to help in his lab. SpongeBob's new friend proves unpopular at camp.
programme.title: Kamp Koral: SpongeBob's Under Years

programme.desc: S1 E18 — Going Green; Tattle Tail Jeanette signs the Chipmunks and the Chipettes up for a green living competition; Alvin agrees to look after his crush's talking bird.
programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants

programme.desc: S2 E10 — Who's Complaining?/Patrick's Star Krabs puts Squidward in charge of all camp complaints. Patrick received a star on his birthday.
programme.title: Kamp Koral: SpongeBob's Under Years

programme.title: Kamp Koral: SpongeBob's Under Years

programme.desc: S1 E20 — Kiss Conspiracy; House Guests Simon is too embarrassed to kiss his co-star in the school play; Alvin decides to rent out the family's house for a Hawaiian home swap.
programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks

programme.desc: S1 E21 — Theozilla; Doggone It When Alvin is paired with Simon to work on a science project, he accidentally creates a potion that turns Theodore into a giant. When all the children's phones go missing at school, Alvin is blamed for the theft and sets out to clear his name.
programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants

programme.title: Kamp Koral: SpongeBob's Under Years

programme.title: Kamp Koral

programme.desc: S1 E22 — Mutiny; Reality or Not Desperate to avenge last year's humiliating loss, the chipmunks argue over who is best suited to lead them to victory; Alvin grows tired of seeing his celebrity status overshadowed by reality TV stars, so he decides to become one himself.
programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks

programme.desc: S1 E24 — Alvin's Secret Powers; Warbie In order to get Theodore to do his bidding, Alvin tells him that he has secret powers and can turn rubbish into candy; when the chipmunks find a baby bird that has fallen from its nest, Alvin is reluctant to get too attached.
programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks

programme.desc: S4 E7 — Have You Seen This Snail? When SpongeBob forgets to feed Gary, he runs away to downtown Bikini Bottom and ends up at a very comfortable house of a kind old woman.
programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants

programme.title: Kamp Koral: SpongeBob's Under Years

programme.desc: S1 E21 — The Switch Glitch; Prickly Pests An accident causes Patrick and Karen to switch bodies; a mischievous camp prank goes terribly wrong.
programme.title: Kamp Koral: SpongeBob's Under Years

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks

programme.desc: S1 E13 — Slippin Thru My Fingers; Driving Dave Crazy The Chipmunks decide to find Dave a new girlfriend. The Chipmunks accidentally ruin Dave's new song for a music festival.
programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks

programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts Sibelius' tone poems and Bruckner's radiant Seventh Symphony, where vast landscapes merge with the human soul.

programme.desc: S5 E10 — Robert Aldrich A glimpse into the life and career of the filmmaker whose portfolio of work includes 'Vera Cruz, The Big Knife, The Dirty Dozen and The Longest Yard'.

programme.desc: S1 E7 — Technology Gets Personal A look at how the personal computer, the internet and video games all became part of daily life thanks to innovations made during the 1980s.

programme.desc: Jonas Kaufmann performs opera masterpieces at the iconic Arena di Verona.
programme.title: Jonas Kaufmann at Arena Di Verona

programme.desc: S1 E3 — How to Paint Trees Adebanji Alade's passion for trees is completely infectious - we marvelled at the way he looks at them, and through his eyes we see so much more, so here we share his palette and techniques which we hope you'll love.
programme.title: Artist of the Year: Masterclass

programme.desc: S1 E4 — Miniature Portraits Series winner Morag Caister often brought us to tears with her outstanding ability to capture the essence of a sitter in very few lines. In this episode, she will show you how to do the same on a miniature scale and prove that less is more.
programme.title: Artist of the Year: Masterclass

programme.title: Tales of the Unexpected

programme.desc: S5 E9 — A Harmless Vanity When her best friend Liz tells her that her husband George is having an affair with the much younger Carol, Mary Hitchman decides to meet her rival and invites her to a civilised beach party.
programme.title: Tales of the Unexpected

programme.desc: S4 E21 — Relative Value A young man lives a life of excess that leads him into considerable debt and a desperate scheme to fix his financial woes by speeding up the inheritance of his rich uncle's estate.
programme.title: Alfred Hitchcock Presents

programme.desc: S4 E22 — The Right Price A burglar finds himself bargaining with one of his victims when he discovers that committing a robbery will not be nearly as profitable as collecting on a lucrative life insurance policy.
programme.title: Alfred Hitchcock Presents

programme.desc: S2 E4 — You'll Be the Death of Me A woman (Pilar Seurat) becomes the target of her murderous spouse after finding a victim's button.
programme.title: Alfred Hitchcock Hour

programme.title: Discovering Film

programme.desc: S5 E10 — Death Can Add An employee successfully manages to defraud his company, but then an accountant discovers his secret.
programme.title: Tales of the Unexpected

programme.title: Tales of the Unexpected

programme.desc: S4 E23 — I'll Take Care of You A desperate used car salesman devises a murderous scheme to bring an end to the extravagant lifestyle of his spendthrift wife, but an unexpected complication puts his plans in jeopardy.
programme.title: Alfred Hitchcock Presents

programme.desc: S4 E24 — The Avon Emeralds A police inspector goes on the trail of an elegant aristocratic woman suspected of plotting to smuggle an expensive emerald necklace out of the country, but all may not be as it seems.
programme.title: Alfred Hitchcock Presents

programme.desc: S2 E1 — The Marx Brothers Barry Cryer looks back on the lives and careers of the highly influential family comedy act, with their successful run on Broadway and in film spanning over 40 years.
programme.title: Comedy Legends

programme.desc: S14 E10 — Emma Thompson Explore the career of one of Britain's most celebrated actresses and screenwriters, the Academy Award-winning Dame Emma Thompson, whose roles include 'Sense and Sensibility' and 'Love Actually'.

programme.title: Tales of the Unexpected

programme.title: Friends

programme.title: Friends

programme.title: Friends

programme.title: Friends

programme.title: Friends

programme.title: Friends

programme.title: Friends

programme.title: Friends

programme.title: AUSTRALIAN GOLF ARCHIVE - 2013: Rory McIlroy Aus Open Knockout Win

programme.title: AUSTRALIAN GOLF ARCHIVE - 2015: Matt Jones Soars in Aus Open Win

programme.title: AUSTRALIAN GOLF ARCHIVE - 2016: Speith's Second Aus Open Win
programme.desc: 2016: Speith's Second Aus Open Win. Royal Sydney Golf Club: Jordan Speith squeezes into a three-way play-off with Australians Ashley Hall and Cameron Smith, then duly banked an uphill 15-footer for birdie to win a gripping tournament.

programme.title: AUSTRALIAN GOLF ARCHIVE - 2019: Australian Open Men's

programme.title: AUSTRALIAN GOLF ARCHIVE - 1984: Tom Watson Australian Open Triumph

programme.title: AUSTRALIAN GOLF ARCHIVE - 1985: Greg Norman Wins Historic Aus Open

programme.title: AUSTRALIAN GOLF ARCHIVE - 1987: Greg Norman Makes Aus Open History

programme.title: AUSTRALIAN GOLF ARCHIVE - 1995: Greg Norman Wins Fourth Aus Open

programme.title: Friends

programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S9 E1 — The One Where No One Proposes Due to a misunderstanding, Rachel finds herself engaged to Joey instead of Ross shortly after giving birth to her and Ross's baby girl. Meanwhile, Joey can't help taking a look as Rachel tries unsuccessfully to nurse her baby. Inspired to have a baby of their own, Monica and Chandler retire to a hospital cupboard for a little privacy.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S9 E6 — The One With the Male Nanny Ross mocks Rachel's new male nanny, and Chandler becomes upset when Monica says that somebody from her job is the funniest guy she's ever met.
programme.title: Friends

programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S9 E8 — The One With Rachel's Other Sister On the night before Thanksgiving, Rachel's self-centred younger sister Amy ruins everyone's holiday dinner with her uncensored observations. programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S9 E11 — The One Where Rachel Goes Back to Work When Rachel returns to her office to show off baby Emma, she is surprised to find handsome temp Gavin has been doing her job while she has been away on maternity leave. programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S9 E12 — The One With Phoebe's Rats Phoebe and Mike parent baby rats born in her cabinet, Rachel gets steamed after Monica invites a rival to her birthday bash, and Joey likes Emma's new nanny.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S9 E13 — The One Where Monica Sings While Rachel tries to sort out her mixed feelings for her handsome colleague Gavin, Ross recruits Chandler to help him meet attractive women and make Rachel jealous. Meanwhile, Phoebe regrets bringing Monica to a karaoke night when she takes the microphone and delights in the applause, unaware that the men in the audience are cheering because they can see through her dress, and Joey submits to painful eyebrow waxing.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S9 E14 — The One With the Blind Dates Joey and Phoebe conspire to arrange awful dates for both Rachel and Ross, hoping that appreciation of their former relationship will push them back together. Meanwhile, the ovulating Monica wants to get intimate with Chandler.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S9 E15 — The One With the Mugging Joey stumbles upon a way to impress a famous actor during an audition, Ross learns the identity of a long-ago mugger, and Chandler accepts an internship at a shoe company.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S9 E16 — The One With the Boob Job Monica secretly asks Joey for a loan because she and Chandler are strapped for cash, Phoebe invites her boyfriend to move in with her, and Rachel's apartment baby-proofing drives Joey crazy.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S9 E17 — The One With the Memorial Service When Chandler jokingly posts an outrageous biography about Ross on Ross' college alumni website, Ross retaliates in kind, sparking an internet war. programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S9 E18 — The One With the Lottery Hoping to win a huge jackpot, the friends pool their money and buy dozens of lottery tickets, but they argue over how to spend the fortune if they win, and Monica irritates everyone else by buying tickets just for her and Chandler. programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: This documentary explores the Moonies cult, examining its rise through mass weddings and matchmaking, and revealing allegations of family separation, control, and hidden secrets from former members.

programme.desc: Erin attends a disastrous dinner party with Jake s family, while Tommo searches for unusual furniture for the Rat and Cutter.

programme.title: Everybody's Fine

programme.title: House of Lust

programme.title: Arthur's Hallowed Ground

programme.title: Victoria and Abdul
programme.desc: The extraordinary true story of an unexpected friendship in the later years of Queen Victoria's (Academy Award winner Judi Dench) remarkable rule. When Abdul Karim (Ali Fazal), a young clerk, travels from India to participate in the Queen's Golden Jubilee, he is surprised to fi nd favor with the Queen herself. As the Queen questions the constrictions of her long-held position, the two forge an unlikely and devoted alliance with a loyalty to one another that her household and inner circle all attempt to destroy. As the friendship deepens, the Queen begins to see a changing world through new eyes and joyfully reclaims her humanity.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In the late 60s, Camaros, Mustangs, and Corvettes roared to the forefront of the muscle car world. When Ray gets offered a spot in a vintage race featuring these cars, he’s propelled to dive into their history and afforded a chance to get behind the wheel at the Brickyard. But because it is a pro-am race, Ray pulls in a partner – none other than Bill Elliott, aka “Awesome Bill from Dawsonville.”.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Everyone has a car they fell in love with. Maybe it was the first? Maybe it was the hot rod the guy down the street owned? In Ray’s case, it was the ’58 Chevy he saw in the iconic coming of age car movie, American Graffiti. When Ray gets the chance to own the car after years and years of pursuit, he jumps on it. But restoring the car to its "movie state" proves to be a grueling task that goes way beyond a typical build. But when it's you first love, you can't let her down.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.sub-title: Graveyard Carz - Willie, Paint it Black?
programme.desc: With SEMA 2018 looming on the horizon, it’s time to address the elephant in the room. Mark’s 1964 A100 Hemi truck, the Little Dead Wagon, built as an homage to Bill Maverick’s Little Red Wagon. Will is set to prime and paint, but has a disagreement with Mark over the color. When the engine for the A100 shows up it’s time to unbox one of the most powerful engines Graveyard Carz has ever put in a car!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark and the Ghouls get down to work like never before in order to get the A100 ready for SEMA which is only weeks away. Brakes, suspension, tail lights, bed sealer, you name it and the Mopar Maniacs are racing to get it done. With time flying and stress mounting the team works long hours and weekends trying to finish this iconic build. With SEMA only days away, the A100 finally gets it’s iconic 426 HEMI engine, well, if they can make it fit!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.sub-title: Night of the Little Dead Wagon - Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: There is no time left, SEMA is almost here but the iconic A100 still needs some buttoning up. Installing all of the final components is an all hands on deck task and when the dust settles, Mark has only the decals left to put on the car, completing its legendary look. With the A100 finished the team heads out to SEMA in order to roll the Little Dead Wagon over the red carpet for Mopar and Mark once again receives a very kind gift from our friends.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: When Mark get’s started talking about a car there is almost no stopping him. So it is again when Mark picks multiple years of a favorite Mopar of his and tells both the audience, and whoever will listen all about their amazing options and cool differences. The Ghouls join in on the fun just like last time to pick their favorite things as well. Don’t worry, though, he can’t talk forever right?

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.sub-title: Graveyard Carz - Duster In The Wind
programme.desc: With SEMA over the Ghoulz can finally rest and get back to work on all the cars they had to leave untouched for the last few weeks…again. First up on deck is our beautiful 1972 Duster. Needing it’s Dash installed as well as it’s interior there is still a lot of work left on this car! Additionally, metal work has begun on a host of new cars moving up through the shop, it never stops at Graveyard Carz.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: A 1970 Challenger is a special thing, but a B5 Challenger is even more special. With the bumblebee stripe finally added to the car it’s time for the work to really begin. Work begins on all the things that make this 1970 Challenger special, including the headliner, dash, interior and more. With that done it’s time for this beautiful Challenger to get its 440 Six Pack!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.sub-title: Graveyard Carz - The Last WS27R on Earth
programme.desc: The time has finally come. Brett Torino is coming and he is here for his car, the legendary 1 of 2 ever made, 1970 Coronet! Mark wouldn’t be Mark, though, without a few tricks up his sleeve. When Brett arrives to collect on his long restoration from the Mopar Master, the reveal of this truly one of a kind car is done with style. But not before Mark takes us back through the entire restoration leading up to that point. It Is the last 1970 Hemi Coronet Convertible on earth, after all.

With just days until the race - Dale is secretly struggling to get the bike he beat Matt with last year up and working. Matt struggles just to locate a 100-year old bike. Matt's prayers are answered thanks to an old Catholic Priest he located who has possession of a bike. The priest might let Matt have the bike to race - but there are conditions. The toughest one: Don't tell Dale you have it. Can Matt afford to buy the bike and get it running in time for the race without Dale seeing it? Will Dale even get his broken bike started? And if they ever get to race, will Matt exact his revenge?

programme.sub-title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 203
programme.desc: Built in the mid-60’s by eccentric engineer “Wild Bill” Gelbke, the Road Dog was, and still is, the largest motorcycle ever built. It utilized aircraft tubing, Corvette disc brakes, and a Chevy truck differential to keep it stable. The one-off creation disappeared when Gelbke did in 1978. Outflanked once when the bike was spotted and sold to a private collector in 1995, Dale has vowed to locate the machine and make Wheels Through Time its final resting place.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "A Sniper Rifle, a Zeppelin, a Ka-Bar Knife, and Dragon Eggs"
programme.sub-title: A Sniper Rifle, a Zeppelin, a Ka-Bar Knife, and Dragon Eggs
programme.desc: In 48 hours, a block of metal will be formed into the most accurate weapon on earth: the AX-338 Sniper Rifle. In a warzone, police stand off, or hostage taking, the sniper is often the only solution to a bad situation.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "An Amphibious Armoured Vehicle, a Bomb Robot, and a Life Raft"
programme.sub-title: An Amphibious Armoured Vehicle, a Bomb Robot, and a Life Raft
programme.desc: When a steel plated hull is fitted with controls on the inside and tracks on the outside, it’ll become the Viking BVS10 –an armoured amphibious personnel carrier that can get troops in and out of any combat zone, even if it has to go through snow, sand, or water to get there.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "A Helmet, a Zippo, a Fuel Bladder, and a Simulated IED"
programme.sub-title: A Helmet, a Zippo, a Fuel Bladder, and a Simulated IED
programme.desc: When a series of delicate snowflake shaped sheets of Aramid are pressed together, they’ll form a piece of headgear that’s comfortable enough to wear to war, and tough enough to take a bullet.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "A Pistol, a Firetruck, a Ghillie Suit, and an Armored Fighting Vehicle"
programme.sub-title: A Pistol, a Firetruck, a Ghillie Suit, and an Armored Fighting Vehicle
programme.desc: At the Cabot factory in Pennsylvania, USA, a block of steel will be transformed by innovation and artistry into the ultimate update of an American classic. The 1911 did tours of duty in both world wars and Vietnam, and is still prized today by collectors and enthusiasts.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "A Cannon, a Parachute, a Medal, and a Stretcher"
programme.sub-title: A Cannon, a Parachute, a Medal, and a Stretcher
programme.desc: A battle tank is only as effective as its gun, and for the Stryker vehicle, that’s the M68 105mm cannon. A tube of forged steel will be hammered into the one of the most powerful and famous cannons in modern warfare.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "A Grenade Launcher, a Flight Simulator, and Ration Packs"
programme.sub-title: A Grenade Launcher, a Flight Simulator, and Ration Packs
programme.desc: The M203 Grenade Launcher is a single shot launcher designed to attach under a rifle barrel. Using the latest technology, bits of plastic and a block of aluminum will be melted, molded, and cut to create a snap-on weapon that increases the firepower in a soldier’s hands by a long shot.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "Jaws of Life, a Tank, and a Watch"
programme.sub-title: Jaws of Life, a Tank, and a Watch
programme.desc: A series of handcrafted, precision-cut pieces will come together to create a first response tool capable of chewing through metal like a can opener. At the scene of an accident, a natural disaster, or in the combat zone, the Jaws of Life can cut through just about anything .

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "An F16, a Sword, and Simulated Ammunition"
programme.sub-title: An F16, a Sword, and Simulated Ammunition
programme.desc: Brainpower and firepower transform 8,000 kilograms of computer-controlled machinery into a legendary dogfighter with the best fight and flight record in the sky; the Lockheed Martin F16.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "Camouflage Makeup, a Machine Gun, and an Amphibious Military ATV"
programme.sub-title: Camouflage Makeup, a Machine Gun, and an Amphibious Military ATV
programme.desc: Developed from solidified vegetable oil, this military grade compound is a long way from department store concealer: it’s sweat proof, infrared resistant, and stays on in the drenching downpour. For soldiers, especially Special Ops and snipers, camo paint completes their covert coverage.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "Combat Boots, a Pistol, a UAV, and a Riflescope"
programme.sub-title: Combat Boots, a Pistol, a UAV, and a Riflescope
programme.desc: For the soldier, the army boot is more than protective footwear. From the parade ground to the battlefield, the boot is a symbol of discipline and determination that marches the soldier right through his military career.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "A Rugged Case, a Precision Aerial Delivery System, a Military Survival Shelter, and an Armoured Personnel Carrier"
programme.sub-title: A Rugged Case, a Precision Aerial Delivery System, a Military Survival Shelter, and an Armoured Personnel Carrier
programme.desc: Polyethylene is measured and molded, heated and cooled to create a rugged and air-droppable case that’s tougher than the rest. Stronger, lighter, and more durable than their wooden predecessors, these keep out wind, rain, sand, and humidity to ensure that valuable supplies arrive intact.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "Swiss Army Knife, a Sub-Machine Gun, Body Armour, and a Laser Sight"
programme.sub-title: Swiss Army Knife, a Sub-Machine Gun, Body Armour, and a Laser Sight
programme.desc: An iconic knife that’s been an integral part of military culture for more than a hundred years, the Swiss Army Knife has been put in service around the world – and even in space.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Best Ranger Competition"
programme.desc: The US Army Ranger School hosts a 3-day competition to find the best Ranger team, testing elite soldiers in strength, skill, and endurance.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Reconnaissance"
programme.desc: Reconnaissance units operate behind enemy lines, using elite training to gather vital intelligence and expose an enemy’s strengths and weaknesses.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Coalition Training"
programme.desc: Allied forces train together to build teamwork and coordination, ensuring success in combat zones like Iraq and Afghanistan.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Navy Boarding Party"
programme.desc: Modern naval boarding teams train to enforce embargoes, stop smugglers, and confront armed pirates in some of the toughest maritime operations.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Airborne Artillery"
programme.desc: Airborne artillery brings heavy firepower behind enemy lines. At Fort Bragg, we witness elite crews train with precision, strategy, and skill.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Pathfinders"
programme.desc: Pathfinders are elite paratroopers trained to go behind enemy lines, lead air insertions, gather intelligence, and execute high-risk, deadly missions.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Elite Forces"
programme.desc: Elite Forces are specially trained soldiers who carry out extreme, high-risk missions anywhere in the world, anytime they’re needed.

programme.title: War Factories S2 - "Battle For Black Gold"
programme.desc: The story of the discovery and exploitation of the Baku Oilfields in the Russian Caucasus, which forced Stalin and Hitler to face-off in the battle of Stalingrad.

programme.title: War Factories S2 - "Fiat And The Fascists"
programme.desc: The untold story of World War II. No matter how many soldiers or how daring the strategy, a war cannot be won if there are not enough weapons or food.

programme.title: War Factories S2 - "The People's Car"
programme.desc: The untold story of World War II. No matter how many soldiers or how daring the strategy, a war cannot be won if there are not enough weapons or food.

programme.title: War Factories S2 - "Apocalypse Factories"
programme.desc: The incredible story of the arms race to create America's nuclear arms factories.

programme.title: War Factories S2 - "The Kamikaze Bullet"
programme.desc: Japan would create arguably the greatest fighter in WW2 - the Mitsubishi Zero. But their failed War Factories would ultimately reduce the Zero to a Kamikaze plane.

programme.title: War Factories S2 - "Dambuster Factory"
programme.desc: How the Lancaster factory, one of the biggest buildings in Europe at the time, helped to create a truly war-winning weapon.

programme.title: War Factories S2 - "Colt & Kalashnikov"

programme.title: Couples Court With the Cutlers
programme.desc: Dana and Keith Cutler have been practicing law together for almost 30 years. They are legal experts and trial attorneys and are the first married couple to preside over a television courtroom. Dana and Keith are graduates of the University of Missouri-Kansas City School of Law, and their combined knowledge of the law will help them uncover the truth behind couples in need. Dana practices education law with a focus on charter schools, while Keith is a civil defense trial attorney. Together, they use technology, including cellphone forensics, GPS tracking, and DNA evidence among other things, to tackle relationship disputes.

programme.title: Lauren Lake's Paternity Court
programme.desc: Different from other court shows, "Lauren Lake's Paternity Court" acts only on family issues. There are no battles over rent money or damages caused by a car accident. These emotional cases can have life-changing consequences for participants and sometimes new beginnings for individuals. While most suits relate to a child's paternity -- including deadbeat dads and DNA-test determinations -- others involve things like grandparents fighting for visitation rights. Lake's lengthy legal career has specialized in family law, making her a natural fit for this court.

programme.desc: Paul, Perry, and Dan head east of Timmins to the historic waters of Frederick House Lake for a late-season ice adventure under warm, spring-like skies. What starts as a perfect day on the hardwater quickly turns into a multispecies showcase—pike, perch, walleye, and sauger all keep the crew busy as the bite fires up. But as Northern Ontario weather often reminds us, conditions shift fast. With the wind picking up and clouds rolling in, the team wraps up an incredible day and makes their way home, grateful for one more memorable outing before the thaw.

programme.title: FishON! - "Trophy Walleye Adventure on Pierre Lake"
programme.desc: Join us as we kick off Season 7 with an unforgettable adventure north of Cochrane, Ontario, on the pristine waters of Pierre Lake. We team up with Mark Froud from Dunn Right Outfitters, an expert in Northern Ontario fishing, to target trophy walleye. Experience the thrill of reeling in massive catches while surrounded by breathtaking wilderness, and gain valuable tips and insights from Mark to enhance your own fishing techniques. This episode sets the tone for a season filled with excitement, exploration, and exceptional angling.

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing - An Unforgettable Trip, South Lake, Part Two
programme.desc: This show was filmed in late October of 2019. Four months prior, in June of 2019, Tim Carnahan was diagnosed with Glioblastoma, Brain Cancer. According to Tim's medical team, his life expectancy could be between three months and 18 months. Fast forward to now, 2020; today's update is one we hoped would never come. With a heavy heart and tear-filled eyes, we share with you that Tim Carnahan has passed away after battling for close to 12 months. It only fits that the last words to pass his lips were I love you, Lory, and keep fishing. While his time on earth was cut short, the amount of joy he experienced and shared with others was genuinely tremendous and will never be forgotten. If you would like to help out in any way, lory and friends have put together a Go Fund Me page to ease the financial burden of medical bills and afford lory some time to greave and transition into life without Tim. We love you, Tim. Rest in peace, buddy.

programme.title: Meeting with Nature
programme.desc: If you're in tune with nature, RTD is the place for you! Our nature documentaries explore natural wonders, environmental issues and people called to preserve the beauty and diversity of our world.In our films, you'll join a team of marine biologists as they replant Thailand's endangered coral reefs and see how overfishing has made a once-fertile Arctic village look like the Sahara Desert. Check out one of the world's most beautiful ice caverns in Russia's Ural region or the wonder of the Northern Lights in Murmansk. RTD's nature documentaries also expose the manmade threats facing the environment today, from raw sewage in India's sacred Ganges River to plastic micro-bead pollution in the Caribbean Sea.

programme.title: People's Problems
programme.desc: The story of RT Documentary's film Girl Power: Hindi Style is built around the of the 'Pink' Gang or in Hindi, the Gulabi Gang, in India. It is organised by Sampat Pal, a charismatic gang leader and activist who fights for women's rights and protects women from domestic abuse. Sampat Pal's movement Gulabi Gang has become so popular that once people see a woman in a pink sari with a stick, they know better than to mess with her: she is under the protection of Sampat Pal. Sampat gives women victims of domestic abuse classes on self-defence. They learn to fight with a stick and find out ways to safely turn down a man's unwanted attention, which may result in an attack or even rape. However, women's rights in India have a long way to go before they start to work, and the Gulabi Gang initiative is the first big step. Sampat Pal doesn't just focus on the physical side. She also acts as a counsellor for domestic abuse victims or those who find themselves in a difficult situation. Sampat Pal gives support and advice, teaches them self respect. Women from all over the country know Sampat Pal and come to join the Gulabi Gang. But the success of her initiative doesn't only come with the support of women. Sampat Pal is such a good diplomat; she's earned the respect of the authorities, who listen to her. This is why a lot of what she does for women's rights in India is so effective. What significant changes in the lives of Indian women has Sampat Pal made with the Gulabi Gang? Watch our film and learn more about this.

programme.title: People's Problems
programme.desc: The story of RT Documentary's film Girl Power: Hindi Style is built around the of the 'Pink' Gang or in Hindi, the Gulabi Gang, in India. It is organised by Sampat Pal, a charismatic gang leader and activist who fights for women's rights and protects women from domestic abuse. Sampat Pal's movement Gulabi Gang has become so popular that once people see a woman in a pink sari with a stick, they know better than to mess with her: she is under the protection of Sampat Pal. Sampat gives women victims of domestic abuse classes on self-defence. They learn to fight with a stick and find out ways to safely turn down a man's unwanted attention, which may result in an attack or even rape. However, women's rights in India have a long way to go before they start to work, and the Gulabi Gang initiative is the first big step. Sampat Pal doesn't just focus on the physical side. She also acts as a counsellor for domestic abuse victims or those who find themselves in a difficult situation. Sampat Pal gives support and advice, teaches them self respect. Women from all over the country know Sampat Pal and come to join the Gulabi Gang. But the success of her initiative doesn't only come with the support of women. Sampat Pal is such a good diplomat; she's earned the respect of the authorities, who listen to her. This is why a lot of what she does for women's rights in India is so effective. What significant changes in the lives of Indian women has Sampat Pal made with the Gulabi Gang? Watch our film and learn more about this.

programme.desc: Started by Natalya Krapkina, a young Russian data analyst from St. Petersburg, the community of Aurora Hunters now counts over a thousand members. Tour agents, designers and shooting instructors by day, by night, these enthusiasts turn into fearless hunters, ready to drive and walk for miles laden with photo equipment to catch a glimpse of Aurora Borealis in the northern skies. The blanket of colourful, shimmering lights is one of the most beautiful natural phenomena in the world. And although St. Petersburg and the European part of Russia are pretty far from where the Northern Light's epicentre, Aurora Hunters rely on preparation and luck, revelling in each new sighting.

programme.title: Meeting with Nature
programme.desc: If you're in tune with nature, RTD is the place for you! Our nature documentaries explore natural wonders, environmental issues and people called to preserve the beauty and diversity of our world.In our films, you'll join a team of marine biologists as they replant Thailand's endangered coral reefs and see how overfishing has made a once-fertile Arctic village look like the Sahara Desert. Check out one of the world's most beautiful ice caverns in Russia's Ural region or the wonder of the Northern Lights in Murmansk. RTD's nature documentaries also expose the manmade threats facing the environment today, from raw sewage in India's sacred Ganges River to plastic micro-bead pollution in the Caribbean Sea.

programme.title: Politics
programme.desc: Find out what lies behind the headlines with RTD's political documentaries. We take you to some of today's major flash points and analyse the players, interests, and motives driving events and trends around the globe. Current affairs and political strategies of the past, great-power standoffs, spy games, international and domestic policies: our political documentaries will keep you up to date with what's happening in the world of politics and help revisit crucial events in the history of global politics.

programme.title: Woman on the Run
programme.desc: After witnessing a murder, Frank Johnson goes on the run to avoid being killed himself. His wife, Eleanor (Ann Sheridan), seems almost apathetic about finding him when questioned by Investigator Harris (Robert Keith), due to a marriage on the rocks. However, after learning that Frank has a grave heart condition, Eleanor recruits reporter Dan Leggett (Dennis O'Keefe) to help track down Frank. Discovering new love for her husband along the way, Eleanor must get to Frank before the killer does.

programme.title: The Bigamist
programme.desc: San Francisco businessman Harry Graham (Edmond O'Brien) and his wife and business partner, Eve (Joan Fontaine), are in the process of adopting a child. When private investigator Jordan (Edmund Gwenn) uncovers the fact that Graham has another wife, Phyllis (Ida Lupino), and a small child in Los Angeles, he confesses everything. In flashback, Graham tells of the strains in his marriage with Eve and how he found himself falling for the kind-hearted waitress Phyllis while on a business trip.

programme.title: Greenland
programme.desc: John Garrity, his estranged wife and their young son embark on a perilous journey to find sanctuary as a planet-killing comet hurtles towards Earth. Amid terrifying accounts of cities getting leveled, the family experiences the best and worst in humanity. As the countdown to the global apocalypse approaches zero, their incredible trek culminates in a desperate, last-minute flight to a possible safe haven.

programme.title: Greenland 2: Migration
programme.desc: In the aftermath of a comet strike that devastates most of the earth, GREENLAND 2: MIGRATION follows devoted family man John Garrity and his wife and son, after they're forced to leave the safety of their bunker in Greenland to search for a new home in a shattered world. John leads the family on a dangerous journey, guided by his burning hope in a rumored safe haven. It's a journey against the odds that will test the family's deepest sense of love, sacrifice and instinct to survive.

programme.title: Normal
programme.desc: The new sheriff of a small town in Minnesota uncovers a dark secret while investigating a botched bank robbery.

programme.title: Eddington
programme.desc: A standoff between a small-town sheriff and mayor sparks a powder keg as neighbor is pitted against neighbor in May 2020 in Eddington, N.M.

programme.title: Skyscraper
programme.desc: Will Sawyer is a former FBI agent and U.S. war veteran who now assesses security for skyscrapers. While he's on assignment in China, the world's tallest and safest building catches on fire -- and Will gets framed for it. Now a wanted man and on the run, he must find those responsible, clear his name and somehow rescue his family members when they become trapped inside the inferno.

programme.title: Project X
programme.desc: Thomas (Thomas Mann), Costa (Oliver Cooper) and JB (Jonathan Daniel Brown) are three anonymous high-school seniors who are determined to finally make their mark. But how to make themselves unforgettable in the annals of high-school history? With an epic party, of course! The idea is innocent enough, but nothing could prepare the three friends for this shindig. As word of the soirée's awesomeness spreads, dreams are ruined, records are blemished, and legends are born.

programme.title: Dear Ms.: A Revolution in Print
programme.desc: A deep dive into the storied and complex legacy of "Ms." magazine through the lens of some of its covers.

programme.title: Jane Fonda in Five Acts
programme.desc: A look at the life, work, activism and controversies of actress and fitness tycoon Jane Fonda.

programme.title: Final Destination
programme.desc: Alex Browning is embarking on a trip to Paris. He experiences a premonition -- he sees the plane explode moments after leaving the ground. Insisting that everyone get off the plane, Alex and seven other people are forced to disembark. All watch as the plane actually explodes in a fireball. He and the other survivors have briefly cheated death, but will not be able to evade their fate for very long. One by one, these fugitives from fate fall victim to the grim reaper.

programme.title: Final Destination 2
programme.desc: Kimberly (A.J. Cook) has a premonition of a horrible highway accident killing multiple people -- including her and her friends. She blocks the cars behind her on the ramp from joining traffic -- and as a police trooper (Michael Landes) arrives, the accident actually happens. Now, Death is stalking this group of mistaken survivors -- and one by one they are dying as they were supposed to on the highway.

programme.title: Final Destination 3
programme.desc: Six years after a group of high-school students first cheated death, another teen (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) has a premonition that she and her friends will be involved in a horrifying roller-coaster accident. When the vision proves true, the student and her fellow survivors must deal with the repercussions of cheating the Grim Reaper.

programme.title: Final Destination 5
programme.desc: During a bus ride with his colleagues to a corporate retreat, Sam (Nicholas D'Agosto) experiences a horrifying vision: the suspension bridge that they -- and many others -- are crossing starts to crumble around them. When his vision ends and, almost immediately, starts to come true, Sam takes quick action that saves a number of people, including his girlfriend, Molly (Emma Bell), and his best friend, Peter (Miles Fisher). However, the survivors soon find that Death will not be denied.

programme.title: Final Destination Bloodlines
programme.desc: Plagued by a violent and recurring nightmare, a college student heads home to track down the one person who might be able to break the cycle of death and save her family from the grisly demise that inevitably awaits them all.

programme.title: Zombieland
programme.desc: Nerdy college student Columbus (Jesse Eisenberg) has survived the plague that has turned mankind into flesh-devouring zombies because he's scared of just about everything. Gun-toting, Twinkie-loving Tallahassee (Woody Harrelson) has no fears. Together, they are about to stare down their most horrifying challenge yet: each other's company. Emma Stone and Abigail Breslin co-star in this double-hitting, head-smashing comedy.

programme.title: Zombieland: Double Tap
programme.desc: Zombie slayers Tallahassee, Columbus, Wichita and Little Rock leave the confines of the White House to travel to Graceland in Memphis, Tenn. Along the way, they encounter other post-apocalyptic warriors and a group of survivors who find refuge in a commune. The scrappy fighters must now rely on their wits and weapons more than ever as they soon find themselves in a relentless battle against smarter, faster and seemingly indestructible zombies.

programme.title: The Long Walk
programme.desc: Teens participate in a grueling high-stakes contest where they must continuously walk or be shot by a member of their military escort.

programme.title: How to Make a Killing
programme.desc: Disowned by his obscenely wealthy family, Becket Redfellow will stop at nothing to reclaim his inheritance, no matter how many relatives stand in his way.

programme.title: One Battle After Another
programme.desc: Bob is a washed-up revolutionary who lives in a state of stoned paranoia, surviving off-grid with his spirited and self-reliant daughter, Willa. When his evil nemesis resurfaces and Willa goes missing, the former radical scrambles to find her as both father and daughter battle the consequences of their pasts.

programme.title: Taken 2
programme.desc: Two years ago, retired CIA agent Bryan Mills (Liam Neeson) used his "particular set of skills" to rescue his daughter, Kim (Maggie Grace), from kidnappers. Since then, Kim has been learning self-defense from her father, and Bryan has been on a personal mission to reunite with his ex-wife (Famke Janssen). In Istanbul, Bryan and his family cross paths with Murad (Rade Serbedzija), whose son died at Bryan's hand during Kim's rescue. Murad wants revenge, and he'll stop at nothing to get it.

programme.title: Deadpool 2
programme.desc: Wisecracking mercenary Deadpool meets Russell, an angry teenage mutant who lives at an orphanage. When Russell becomes the target of Cable -- a genetically enhanced soldier from the future -- Deadpool realizes that he'll need some help saving the boy from such a superior enemy. He soon joins forces with Bedlam, Shatterstar, Domino and other powerful mutants to protect young Russell from Cable and his advanced weaponry.

programme.title: Aquaman
programme.desc: Once home to the most advanced civilization on Earth, the city of Atlantis is now an underwater kingdom ruled by the power-hungry King Orm. With a vast army at his disposal, Orm plans to conquer the remaining oceanic people -- and then the surface world. Standing in his way is Aquaman, Orm's half-human, half-Atlantean brother and true heir to the throne. With help from royal counselor Vulko, Aquaman must retrieve the legendary Trident of Atlan and embrace his destiny as protector of the deep.

programme.title: Aquaman and the Lost Kingdom
programme.desc: After failing to defeat Aquaman the first time, Black Manta wields the power of the mythic Black Trident to unleash an ancient and malevolent force. Hoping to end his reign of terror, Aquaman forges an unlikely alliance with his brother, Orm, the former king of Atlantis. Setting aside their differences, they join forces to protect their kingdom and save the world from irreversible destruction.

programme.title: Annabelle
programme.desc: John Form thinks he's found the perfect gift for his expectant wife, Mia: a vintage doll in a beautiful white dress. However, the couple's delight doesn't last long: One terrible night, devil worshipers invade their home and launch a violent attack against the couple. When the cultists try to summon a demon, they smear a bloody rune on the nursery wall and drip blood on Mia's doll, thereby turning the former object of beauty into a conduit for ultimate evil.

programme.title: Annabelle: Creation
programme.desc: Former toy maker Sam Mullins and his wife, Esther, are happy to welcome a nun and six orphaned girls into their California farmhouse. Years earlier, the couple's 7-year-old daughter Annabelle died in a tragic car accident. Terror soon strikes when one child sneaks into a forbidden room and finds a seemingly innocent doll that appears to have a life of its own.

programme.title: The Conjuring
programme.desc: In 1970, paranormal investigators and demonologists Lorraine (Vera Farmiga) and Ed (Patrick Wilson) Warren are summoned to the home of Carolyn (Lili Taylor) and Roger (Ron Livingston) Perron. The Perrons and their five daughters have recently moved into a secluded farmhouse, where a supernatural presence has made itself known. Though the manifestations are relatively benign at first, events soon escalate in horrifying fashion, especially after the Warrens discover the house's macabre history.

programme.title: The Conjuring 2
programme.desc: In 1977, paranormal investigators Ed (Patrick Wilson) and Lorraine Warren come out of a self-imposed sabbatical to travel to Enfield, a borough in north London. There, they meet Peggy Hodgson, an overwhelmed single mother of four who tells the couple that something evil is in her home. Ed and Lorraine believe her story when the youngest daughter begins to show signs of demonic possession. As the Warrens try to help the besieged girl, they become the next targets of the malicious spirit.

programme.title: Dune
programme.desc: Paul Atreides, a brilliant and gifted young man born into a great destiny beyond his understanding, must travel to a dangerous planet in the universe to ensure the future of his family and his people. As malevolent forces explode into conflict over the planet's exclusive supply of a precious resource in existence, only those who can conquer their own fear will survive.

programme.title: Dune: Part Two
programme.desc: Paul Atreides unites with Chani and the Fremen while seeking revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family. Facing a choice between the love of his life and the fate of the universe, he must prevent a terrible future only he can foresee.

programme.title: Mortal Kombat
programme.desc: Lord Raiden (Christopher Lambert) handpicks three martial artists — federal agent Sonya Blade (Bridgette Wilson), Shaolin monk Liu Kang (Robin Shou) and action movie sensation Johnny Cage (Linden Ashby) — and mentors them. After intense training, Raiden transports the trio to Outworld, the site of an interdimensional fighting tournament. There, the three humans must defeat the demonic warriors of the evil Shang Tsung (Cary-Hiroyuki Tagawa) — or allow Tsung to take over the Earth.

programme.title: Mortal Kombat II
programme.desc: Johnny Cage joins other fighters in the ultimate, no-holds-barred battle to defeat the dark rule of Shao Kahn, a powerful tyrant who threatens the very existence of the Earthrealm and its defenders.

programme.title: Being Mary Tyler Moore
programme.desc: Chronicling the vanguard career of Mary Tyler Moore, weaving her personal narrative with the beats of her professional accomplishments, highlighting her groundbreaking roles and the indelible impact she had on generations of women who came after her.

programme.title: How to Survive a Pandemic
programme.desc: An inside look at the historic, multinational race to research, develop, regulate and roll out COVID-19 vaccines in the war against the coronavirus pandemic.

programme.title: In the Same Breath
programme.desc: A look at how the Chinese government turned pandemic cover-ups in Wuhan into a triumph for the Communist Party.

programme.title: Frederick Douglass: In Five Speeches
programme.desc: Acclaimed actors perform the speeches of Frederick Douglass with context from famed scholars, also with readings from his autobiographies to illustrate how his words about racial injustice still resonate deeply today.

programme.title: Isle of Dogs
programme.desc: When, by executive decree, all the canine pets of Megasaki City are exiled to a vast garbage-dump called Trash Island, 12-year-old Atari sets off alone in a miniature Junior-Turbo Prop and flies across the river in search of his bodyguard-dog, Spots. There, with the assistance of a pack of newly-found mongrel friends, he begins an epic journey that will decide the fate and future of the entire Prefecture.

programme.title: Life of the Party
programme.desc: When her husband suddenly dumps her, longtime and dedicated housewife Deanna turns regret into reset by going back to college. Unfortunately, Deanna winds up at the same school as her less-than-thrilled daughter. Plunging headlong into the campus experience, the outspoken new student soon starts a journey of self-discovery while fully embracing all the fun, freedom and frat boys that she can handle.

programme.title: Just Friends
programme.desc: High school student Chris Brander (Ryan Reynolds) loves his best friend, Jamie Palamino (Amy Smart). He finally confesses his feelings, but she tells him that she just wants to be friends, and he leaves town in shame. Ten years later, Chris is a successful record executive and involved with self-absorbed pop star Samantha James (Anna Faris). He still pines for Jamie, though, and when his plans to go to Paris for the holidays fall through, he returns to his hometown to try and win her heart.

programme.title: Meet the Parents
programme.desc: Everything that can possibly go wrong for groom-to-be Greg Focker does. The problems start with Greg's disastrous first meeting with his girlfriend's family -- most notably her intimidating father Jack Byrnes, and it's all downhill from there.

programme.title: Meet the Fockers
programme.desc: Now that Greg Focker is "in" with his soon-to-be in-laws, Jack and Dina Byrnes, it looks like smooth sailing for him and his fiancée, Pam. But that's before Pam's parents meet Greg's parents, the Fockers. The hyper-relaxed Fockers and the tightly-wound Byrnes are woefully mismatched from the start, and no matter how hard Greg and Pam try, there is just no bringing their families together. This all adds up to a disastrously funny time of getting to know you.

programme.title: Little Fockers
programme.desc: After 10 years of marriage and two children, it seems that Greg Focker has finally earned a place in the "circle of trust" of his uptight father-in-law, Jack. However, Greg is moonlighting with a drug company, which raises Jack's suspicions. As two clans descend on the scene of the young twins' birthday party, Greg must find a way through myriad misunderstandings to prove to Jack -- once and for all -- that he is worthy of being the next family patriarch.

programme.title: Anyone But You
programme.desc: Despite an amazing first date, Bea and Ben's initial attraction quickly turns sour. However, when they unexpectedly find themselves at a destination wedding in Australia, they pretend to be the perfect couple to keep up appearances.

programme.title: The Invite
programme.desc: Joe and Angela's marriage is on thin ice. When they invite their enigmatic upstairs neighbors for a dinner party, the night spirals into unexpected places.

programme.title: The Roses
programme.desc: Life seems easy for picture-perfect couple Theo and Ivy: successful careers, a loving marriage, great kids. However, a tinderbox of fierce competition and hidden resentments soon emerge when Theo's career nosedives and Ivy's own ambitions take off.

programme.title: Anatomy of a Fall
programme.desc: A woman is suspected of her husband's murder, and their blind son faces a moral dilemma as the sole witness.

programme.title: Les Misérables
programme.desc: After 19 years as a prisoner, Jean Valjean (Hugh Jackman) is freed by Javert (Russell Crowe), the officer in charge of the prison workforce. Valjean promptly breaks parole but later uses money from stolen silver to reinvent himself as a mayor and factory owner. Javert vows to bring Valjean back to prison. Eight years later, Valjean becomes the guardian of a child named Cosette after her mother's (Anne Hathaway) death, but Javert's relentless pursuit means that peace will be a long time coming.

programme.title: How We Get Free
programme.desc: Over the course of two years, Elisabeth Epps works to end cash bail on all fronts, from bailing people out of jail to running for office as one of the first abolitionist candidates in Colorado.

programme.title: Super/Man: The Christopher Reeve Story
programme.desc: Actor Christopher Reeve rises to stardom when he lands the role of Superman in the 1970s. When a horse-riding accident leaves him paralyzed in 1995, Reeve spends the rest of his life searching for a cure for spinal cord injuries.

programme.title: Batman Begins
programme.desc: A young Bruce Wayne travels to the Far East, where he's trained in the martial arts by Henri Ducard, a member of the mysterious League of Shadows. When Ducard reveals the League's true purpose -- the complete destruction of Gotham City -- Wayne returns to Gotham intent on cleaning up the city without resorting to murder. With the help of Alfred, his loyal butler, and Lucius Fox, a tech expert at Wayne Enterprises, Batman is born.

programme.title: Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice
programme.desc: It's been nearly two years since Superman's colossal battle with Zod devastated the city of Metropolis. The loss of life and collateral damage left many feeling angry and helpless, including crime-fighting billionaire Bruce Wayne. Convinced that Superman is now a threat to humanity, Batman embarks on a personal vendetta to end his reign on Earth, while the conniving Lex Luthor launches his own crusade against the Man of Steel.

programme.title: The Batman
programme.desc: Batman ventures into Gotham City's underworld when a sadistic killer leaves behind a trail of cryptic clues. As the scale of the perpetrator's plans become clear, he must bring justice to the abuse of power and corruption that plagues the metropolis.

programme.title: The Wolverine
programme.desc: Lured to a Japan he hasn't seen since World War II, century-old mutant Wolverine (Hugh Jackman) finds himself in a shadowy realm of yakuza and samurai. Wolverine is pushed to his physical and emotional brink when he is forced to go on the run with a powerful industrialist's daughter (Tao Okamoto) and is confronted -- for the first time -- with the prospect of death. As he struggles to rediscover the hero within himself, he must grapple with powerful foes and the ghosts of his own haunted past.

programme.title: Madame Web
programme.desc: Cassandra Webb is a New York City paramedic who starts to show signs of clairvoyance. Forced to confront revelations about her past, she must protect three young women from a mysterious adversary who wants them dead.

programme.title: Fuze
programme.desc: London undergoes a citywide evacuation when an unexploded World War II bomb is unearthed at a busy construction site. Amid the escalating tension and chaos, a daring criminal operation is set in motion -- one that uses the evacuation as a cover for a meticulously planned bank heist. As authorities race against time to contain the crisis, alliances blur and moral boundaries are crossed.

programme.title: The Equalizer 3
programme.desc: Since giving up his life as a government assassin, Robert McCall finds solace in serving justice on behalf of the oppressed. Now living in Southern Italy, he soon discovers his new friends are under the control of local crime bosses. As events turn deadly, McCall becomes their protector by taking on the mafia.

programme.title: American Made
programme.desc: Barry Seal, a TWA pilot, is recruited by the CIA to provide reconnaissance on the burgeoning communist threat in Central America and soon finds himself in charge of one of the biggest covert CIA operations in the history of the United States. The operation spawns the birth of the Medellín cartel and almost brings down the Reagan White House.

programme.title: Breaking In
programme.desc: Shaun Russell takes her son and daughter on a weekend getaway to her late father's secluded, high-tech vacation home in the countryside. The family soon gets an unwelcome surprise when four men break into the house to find hidden money. After managing to escape, Shaun must now figure out a way to turn the tables on the desperate thieves and save her captive children.

programme.title: The Drama
programme.desc: A confession throws the wedding of a seemingly perfect couple off the rails as they spiral to confront whether they can go ahead with the union.

programme.title: Life According to Sam
programme.desc: After they learn that their only child has progeria, Drs. Leslie Gordon and Scott Berns set up a foundation and oversee the development of an experimental drug to treat the rare disorder.

programme.title: Trees, and Other Entanglements
programme.desc: People and the natural world intertwine in the stories of a young boy hidden among trees, an artist refining American bonsai, a photographer observing trees, a mother fighting to protect the forests and a man who steadfastly plants them.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Madea's Witness Protection
programme.desc: For years, mild-mannered Wall Street banker George Needleman (Eugene Levy) has meandered through life oblivious to his family's dysfunction and his company's malfeasance, but he's forced to wake up when he learns that he's been framed in a mob-backed Ponzi scheme. Placed under federal protection, George and his family are shipped down South to Madea's (Tyler Perry) house, where the no-nonsense matriarch whips them all into shape using her special brand of tough love.

programme.title: Mamma Mia! Here We Go Again
programme.desc: In 1979 young Donna, Tanya and Rosie graduate from Oxford University -- leaving Donna free to embark on a series of adventures throughout Europe. On her journeys, she makes the acquaintances of Harry, Bill and Sam -- the latter whom she falls in love with, but he's also the man who breaks her heart. In the present day, Donna's pregnant daughter, Sophie, dreams of renovating a taverna while reuniting with her mother's old friends and boyfriends on the Greek island of Kalokairi.

programme.title: The Color Purple
programme.desc: Torn apart from her sister and her children, Celie faces many hardships in life, including an abusive husband. With support from a sultry singer named Shug Avery, as well as her stand-her-ground stepdaughter, Celie ultimately finds extraordinary strength in the unbreakable bonds of a new kind of sisterhood.

programme.title: Jerry Maguire
programme.desc: When slick sports agent Jerry Maguire (Tom Cruise) has a crisis of conscience, he pens a heartfelt company-wide memo that promptly gets him fired. Desperate to hang on to the athletes that he represents, Jerry starts his own management firm, with only single mother Dorothy Boyd (Renee Zellweger) joining him in his new venture. Banking on their sole client, football player Rod Tidwell (Cuba Gooding Jr.), Jerry and Dorothy begin to fall in love as they struggle to make their business work.

programme.title: Mars Attacks!
programme.desc: A fleet of Martian spacecraft surrounds the world's major cities and all of humanity waits to see if the extraterrestrial visitors have, as they claim, "come in peace." U.S. President James Dale (Jack Nicholson) receives assurance from science professor Donald Kessler (Pierce Brosnan) that the Martians' mission is a friendly one. But when a peaceful exchange ends in the total annihilation of the U.S. Congress, military men call for a full-scale nuclear retaliation.

programme.title: Miss Congeniality
programme.desc: When a terrorist threatens to bomb the Miss United States pageant, the FBI rushes to find a female agent to go undercover as a contestant. Unfortunately, Gracie is the only female FBI agent who can "look the part" despite her complete lack of refinement and femininity. She prides herself in being "just one of the boys" and is horrified at the idea of becoming a girly girl.

programme.title: Practical Magic
programme.desc: Sally and Gillian Owens, born into a magical family, have mostly avoided witchcraft themselves. But when Gillian's vicious boyfriend, Jimmy Angelov, dies unexpectedly, the Owens sisters give themselves a crash course in hard magic. With policeman Gary Hallet growing suspicious, the girls struggle to resurrect Angelov -- and unwittingly inject his corpse with an evil spirit that threatens to end their family line.

programme.title: Superman
programme.desc: When Superman gets drawn into conflicts at home and abroad, his actions are questioned, giving tech billionaire Lex Luthor the opportunity to get the Man of Steel out of the way for good. Will intrepid reporter Lois Lane and Superman's four-legged companion, Krypto, be able to help him before it's too late?

programme.title: The Moment
programme.desc: As her arena tour debut looms, a pop star finds herself caught inside the afterglow of a breakout summer under the mounting pressure of what it costs to stay on top.

programme.title: Death of a Unicorn
programme.desc: A weekend retreat has deadly consequences when a father and daughter accidentally hit and kill a unicorn while en route, and his billionaire boss seeks to exploit the creature's miraculous curative properties.

programme.title: A Clockwork Orange
programme.desc: In an England of the future, Alex and his "Droogs" spend their nights getting high at the Korova Milkbar before embarking on "a little of the old ultraviolence," while jauntily warbling "Singin' in the Rain." After he's jailed for bludgeoning the Cat Lady to death, Alex submits to behavior modification technique to earn his freedom; he's conditioned to abhor violence. Returned to the world defenseless, Alex becomes the victim of his prior victims.

programme.title: 1000% Me: Growing Up Mixed
programme.desc: Multiracial children and their families share the joys and struggles of growing up mixed in the Bay Area.

programme.title: Class Divide
programme.desc: Filmmaker Marc Levin examines income inequality and gentrification in Chelsea, N.Y.

programme.title: Music Box: Wizkid: Long Live Lagos
programme.desc: Tracing the roots and global rise of Nigerian superstar Wizkid as he prepares for his first major stadium concert.

programme.title: Skyscraper
programme.desc: Will Sawyer is a former FBI agent and U.S. war veteran who now assesses security for skyscrapers. While he's on assignment in China, the world's tallest and safest building catches on fire -- and Will gets framed for it. Now a wanted man and on the run, he must find those responsible, clear his name and somehow rescue his family members when they become trapped inside the inferno.

programme.title: The Revenant
programme.desc: While exploring the uncharted wilderness in 1823, frontiersman Hugh Glass (Leonardo DiCaprio) sustains life-threatening injuries from a brutal bear attack. When a member (Tom Hardy) of his hunting team kills his young son (Forrest Goodluck) and leaves him for dead, Glass must utilize his survival skills to find a way back to civilization. Grief-stricken and fueled by vengeance, the legendary fur trapper treks through the snowy terrain to track down the man who betrayed him.

programme.title: Rocky
programme.desc: Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone), a small-time boxer from working-class Philadelphia, is arbitrarily chosen to take on the reigning world heavyweight champion, Apollo Creed (Carl Weathers), when the undefeated fighter's scheduled opponent is injured. While training with feisty former bantamweight contender Mickey Goldmill (Burgess Meredith), Rocky tentatively starts a relationship with Adrian (Talia Shire), the wallflower sister of his meat-packer pal Paulie (Burt Young).

programme.title: Rocky II
programme.desc: Although working-class Philadelphia boxer Rocky Balboa lost his high-profile bout with the cocky world champion Apollo Creed, his Cinderella story has caught the national sports media's attention, and he now has the opportunity to capitalize on his sudden fame. Meanwhile, Creed is still smarting from almost losing to some palooka no one has ever heard of, and arrogantly prods his newfound nemesis into getting back into the ring.

programme.title: Rocky III
programme.desc: Following his crushing defeat by Clubber Lang, Rocky Balboa joins forces with Apollo Creed in an effort to regain his title.

programme.title: Rocky V
programme.desc: Recently retired boxer Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) falls on hard times after his accountant mismanages his finances. He stages a comeback of sorts by mentoring fiery young boxer Tommy (Tommy Morrison), while also trying to mend his shaky relationship with his own son, Robert (Sage Stallone). These challenges prove to be at least as tough as any fight Rocky has faced in the ring. He wonders if he will be able to meet them and raise his arms in victory again.

programme.title: Rocky IV
programme.desc: Heavyweight champion Rocky Balboa trains in Siberia for a match against the Soviet fighter who killed Apollo Creed. In front of a ferocious Russian crowd, he fights for one final showdown.

programme.title: Creed
programme.desc: Adonis Johnson (Michael B. Jordan) never knew his famous father, boxing champion Apollo Creed, who died before Adonis was born. However, boxing is in his blood, so he seeks out Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) and asks the retired champ to be his trainer. Rocky sees much of Apollo in Adonis, and agrees to mentor him, even as he battles an opponent deadlier than any in the ring. With Rocky's help, Adonis soon gets a title shot, but whether he has the true heart of a fighter remains to be seen.

programme.title: Forbidden: Dying for Love
programme.desc: A rookie police officer meets a beautiful exotic dancer; he keeps secrets from his sergeants and his new girlfriend, and he'll stop at nothing to keep his double life secret.

programme.title: Forbidden: Dying for Love
programme.desc: A decorated U.S. Marine falls for a married woman; suspicion and jealousy plague their affair, and the stakes are so high, they'll stop at nothing to keep it hidden from their spouses.

programme.desc: A Christian woman's faith is tested when she falls in love with a charming new female coworker; as the lovers fight for their love in a community that doesn't want them, the pressure proves to be too much, and the consequences are deadly.

programme.desc: Love and tradition collide when a young woman falls for a handsome stranger; she knows she must keep her relationship hidden from her orthodox father and protective brother.

programme.desc: A teenage girl falls hard for an NYPD officer; he promises to make all her dreams come true, but when affairs of the heart are complicated by the letter of the law, someone will pay the price.

programme.desc: A teenage boy's traditional parents try to keep him away from his girlfriend by moving him to another country, but the distance only serves to make his heart grow fonder, and he will stop at nothing to be reunited with his girl.
